Kont1go Construction, general contractor in Riverside

Kont1go Construction is led by owner Oscar Reyes. We handle general remodeling and new builds, and we are comfortable at every stage, from foundation and framing to the final tile and trim.

Whether you want a new kitchen, a rebuilt bathroom, a backyard guest house or a stamped concrete patio, you work directly with the owner and one team from start to finish.
